subject.title: feat: add Podman agent sandbox backend

question: Should `backend: "docker"` and `sandbox.allowBackends: ["docker"]` be allowed to execute through Podman automatically when the Docker executable is absent?
rationale: This deliberately changes a shipped failure path and makes configured policy identity differ from the effective isolation engine, which requires owner intent rather than an automated correctness judgment.

options.title: Require explicit Podman
options.body: Keep the new Podman backend but remove automatic fallback so existing Docker configuration and authorization retain their shipped meaning.

options.title: Approve Docker-first fallback
options.body: Adopt configured-backend authorization for the fallback, with explicit upgrade/security documentation and current-head proof for both engines and failure paths.

recommendation.title: Require explicit Podman
recommendation.body: Keep the new Podman backend but remove automatic fallback so existing Docker configuration and authorization retain their shipped meaning.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-main history most strongly connects this person to sandbox backend and security-policy decisions.
